title: Server to agent: answers and pushes
description: The server's answers to the Agent API calls (agent-messages.schema.json) and what it pushes on the agent's channel agent.{id}: commands (command.schema.json) and executor assignments. Roadmap step 3 (2026-10-26). Step 5 (2026-10-27): the league's macros policy, the local failsafe the agent should hold (fetched with GET local-failsafe), its rank in the stagger and the steward's release.

reason.description: Why the check failed, for the operator.

helloResult.description: Answer to hello. active with a session when the agent was bound to one: by league and sub-session id, or, with sub-session id 0, to the league's open session. ready with a reason otherwise.

state.description: ready: not part of a session (yet); active: part of a session, publishing data, executing if executor.

epoch.description: Executor epoch. Commands carry it; the agent rejects older ones.

reason.description: Why the agent is not active, for the operator.

macros.description: The league's macros policy: off means the agent switches its macro channel off and types every command.

heartbeatResult.description: Answer to every heartbeat: the server's view, so the agent catches an executor change or a release even if it missed the push.

state.description: ready: not part of a session (yet); active: part of a session, publishing data, executing if executor.

epoch.description: Executor epoch. Commands carry it; the agent rejects older ones.

macros.description: The league's macros policy: off means the agent switches its macro channel off and types every command.

localFailsafeRank.description: The agent's place among the session's active agents (the executor is 0): its local failsafe waits its delay plus 15 s per rank, so agents act one after another. null when not active.

releaseLocalFailsafe.description: A steward released the local failsafe this agent runs: it stops. Sent until the agent reports it is not running.

executorAssignment.description: Pushed on agent.{id} when stewards choose the executor (and to the previous executor, with isExecutor false).

epoch.description: Executor epoch. Commands carry it; the agent rejects older ones.

eventsAck.description: Answer to an event or a resync: the agent may drop buffered events up to this sequence number.

commandList.description: Long-poll fallback while the websocket is down: commands sent to this agent that it has not acknowledged yet.

localFailsafeTarget.description: The local failsafe procedure the agent should hold (spec: Local failsafe): the version its session uses, or the latest published one when it is in no session; null when the league has designated none (the agent deletes its copy). The agent fetches the document when its own version or hash differs.

hash.description: Identifies the version's content; the agent compares it, it does not recompute it.

armPractice.description: The league arms the failsafe in practice as well (Arming and session lifecycle).

armQualify.description: The league arms the failsafe in qualifying as well.

localFailsafeDocument.description: Answer to GET /api/v1/agent/local-failsafe: the procedure the agent should hold, with its version and hash as in localFailsafeTarget. 404 when the league has designated none.

document.description: The published version; only offline blocks (the server checked it when it was designated).
